direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; FactoryStage at least 55vw and 60vh, no page scroll, only inspector and task lists scroll internally
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, preserving the required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on a real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail generated from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating their controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Refit the salmon certificate bar to silver with a hatched mismatch segment so red stays reserved for the stopped station.
Enlarge SVG route and job labels to 11px minimum and lift the 40/30 labels clear of machine outlines.
Add a 2px neon focus ring to Inspect source evidence and each focusable SVG node; announce selection in the inspector.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT, including nonce and identity status, from the investigation task with distinct headings, controls and status regions.
Enlarge the route select to a 44px target with a visible focus ring and label its offline state without relying on color.
Trim the lower inspector copy to one status sentence so Run Sample investigation stays visible without crowding at 1366x768.
Keep the typed consent form visibly bound to the selected option; move focus into the phrase field after selection and return focus to that option on Esc.
Add tabular alignment and a selected marker plus text label to each option so time and cost scan without color alone.
Reduce the repeated option cards inside the stage to a compact accepted-route trace, freeing stage height for the machines.
Preserve PROPOSED UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on every task card and in the DecisionBar until Approve is activated; do not show a tracked count for proposals.
Unclip the MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts route labels where they cross JOB-1001 and JOB-1002; offset labels above the neon path.
Make Decline proposal a 40px secondary button with a focus ring instead of a low-contrast text link.
Label CELL-MILL-2 as PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE with dashed silver outline only; apply stoppedRed cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text only after Apply second shock.
Enlarge the machine select to 44px and pair its focus ring with the matching SVG preview highlight.
Remove the disabled Scenario Management block from the tab order and visual flow until it becomes actionable.
Keep stoppedRed exclusive to CELL-MILL-2; refit the certificate mismatch bar to silver and hatch as on Step 1.
Separate pre-flight nonce and identity health from Reinvestigate recovery, with independent status text and controls.
Add OFFLINE-STOPPED text beside the red cross-hatch and ensure no neon route enters CELL-MILL-2.
Show CONSTRAINED Split available capacity as disabled with pattern, marker and reason text; exclude it from keyboard focus as a selectable option.
Move focus to the typed consent field when a feasible option is selected; keep Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches and say so beside the field.
Compress option card padding so the full consent form and DecisionBar status fit without internal crowding at 768px height.
Keep prior 3 BLOCKED tasks and the approved revised plan visible while replacement t1/t2 remain PROPOSED UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL; label both groups explicitly.
Collapse repeated blocked-task prose into one summary line per task with owner and reason, reducing inspector scroll.
Unclip route labels over JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 and add focus-ring highlighting between task cards and SVG jobs.
Sequence Seal, Verify and Retain as numbered steps with disabled states until each prerequisite completes; never present them as simultaneous awaiting actions.
Add character-count and requirement feedback for the 16-160 character passphrase with a visible focus ring and aria-live result only.
Enlarge BEFORE-AFTER metrics and align 70, 35h and 48h on one tabular baseline.
Replace the active Recovery complete primary with a completion status and a single Lock recovery room action, preventing a duplicate completion signal.
Mask the passphrase permanently and add a text Complete marker to Seal, Verify and Retain so state does not rely on check glyphs alone.
Mark the final rail item aria-current and add a concise sealed-packet summary with 18 events and the retained offline state.
